# Yes Dental

> Yes Dental is a family and cosmetic dental office in Manhattan, New York City (Washington Heights). We offer personal, complete dental care for the whole family in English and Spanish.

- Address: 617 West 181st Street, 2nd Floor, New York, NY 10033
- Phone: (212) 781-0700
- Email: info@yesdental.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM
- Languages: English, Spanish (Spanish pages start with /es/)
- Website: https://www.yesdentalny.com/
